description: List canvas dataframes materialized by bls_get_series or by bls_dataframe_query register_as, with provenance (source tool, query parameters), TTL, row count, and column schema. Use before writing SQL to confirm column names and types. Lazy-sweeps expired tables before responding. Requires CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb.

name.description: Optional dataframe name to describe a single dataframe — a df_XXXXX_XXXXX name from bls_get_series, or a register_as name from bls_dataframe_query. Omit, or leave blank, to list all active dataframes.

name: bls_dataframe_describe

dataframes.description: Active dataframes for this tenant, newest first.

column_schema.description: Column schema — all BLS dataframe columns are nullable.

items.description: Schema descriptor for one column in the dataframe.

type.description: Column type as the canvas reports it: VARCHAR, INTEGER, BIGINT, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN, DATE, TIMESTAMP, JSON, or BLOB. A register_as column of another DuckDB type (DECIMAL, HUGEINT from SUM over integers, SMALLINT, a list) reports VARCHAR, though SQL still sees its real type.

name.description: Canvas table name — df_XXXXX_XXXXX, or the register_as name given.

query_params.description: Input parameters the source tool was called with.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_unavailable`: The DataCanvas service is not configured for this deployment. `invalid_dataframe_name`: name is not blank and is not a canvas identifier, so no dataframe can carry it. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

title: Describe BLS Dataframes
